svg.title: EH3D-SERVER architecture
svg.desc: EH3D-SERVER is a Rust service (axum) with a REST interface and a websocket. Every request needs a token with one of three roles. It plans a drilling or routing job with the libraries of EH3D-DRILLPRO and EH3D-ROUTEPRO, keeps it ready until an operator starts it, and runs it on a machine through its EH3D-NODE-BUNGARD or on a simulator, with the dialogs of the operator and a stop. Everything is tested on a computer against the simulator; nothing has run on a real machine through it, and it does not terminate TLS.

svg.text: The center of the EH3D programs: it plans the jobs, runs them on the machine through its node and tells everybody how they go.
